How WishWait works, your data, and what Ollie can and can\'t do
Thanks for using WishWait. These terms are written in plain words. By using the app, you agree to them.
WishWait is a personal tool that helps you pause before buying. It works without an account, without AI and without ads. Ollie, the owl, gives rule-based suggestions from the numbers you enter.

Ollie\'s waits, tips and calculations are estimates to help you think. They are not financial, legal or tax advice, and Ollie never knows your full situation. Every decision to buy, wait or let go is yours.
3. Your data stays on your phone

Everything you enter (wishes, prices, income, paydays, your goal) is saved only on this device. WishWait has no servers of its own, collects no analytics and shares nothing with anyone. A backup file goes only where you choose to save it, and you are responsible for keeping it safe. If Android backup is on for your phone, Android may also keep a copy in your own Google account backup; the developer never sees it. Uninstalling the app or using \"Erase all data\" deletes your data from this phone. If you turn on Google Drive backup, a copy is also saved in a hidden WishWait folder in your own Google Drive. Only your Google account can open it; the developer can\'t.

When you open Support Ollie, Google Play loads the tip prices and handles any tip you choose to send. Otherwise, only when you share or paste a product link and \"Fill in details from shared links\" is on. WishWait then opens that public page to read its name and price, the same way a browser would. The store sees a normal page visit. You can turn this off anytime in Settings. When Google Drive backup is on, WishWait also sends its backup to your own Google Drive.
Reminders are sent by your phone, only between 9 AM and 9 PM, and only if you allow them. You can switch them off in Settings.

Details read from links can be wrong or out of date, so please check them. Sale days (like 10.10) and Payday Sales are general calendar dates, not offers from any store. WishWait is not connected to or endorsed by any store or shopping app, and store names belong to their owners.
Please use WishWait for your own personal planning, and don\'t try to break, copy or resell the app.

WishWait is provided \"as is\". We work hard to keep it accurate and reliable, but we can\'t promise it will be error-free or always available. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for purchases you make or don\'t make, or for any loss of data or money.
We may update these terms when the app changes. The new version will show in the app with a new effective date. Continuing to use WishWait means you accept the update.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.
